item.title: Another US strike, two more dead: Anti-drug campaign toll crosses 100 — watch
item.description: US forces killed two suspected "male narco-terrorists" in a strike on an alleged drug-smuggling boat in the Eastern Pacific. This brings the total killed in Washington's campaign to at least 107. The military claims intelligence confirmed the vessel's involvement in drug trafficking, though evidence for the strikes remains unprovided, sparking debate over legality.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘I never asked why me’: Erika Kirk on Charlie Kirk’s assassination, faith and why tragedy didn’t change her worldview
item.description: Months after her husband Charlie Kirk's assassination, Erika Kirk remains steadfast in her faith and beliefs. She shared on Fox News Sunday that her trust in God has only deepened, emphasizing that the tragedy has not shaken her conviction.

item.title: Eyeing 2028: JD Vance’s secret role in saving Trump from a Musk revolt
item.description: Vice President JD Vance worked behind the scenes to mediate a growing rift between Donald Trump and tech mogul Elon Musk. Vance's efforts aimed to stabilize Trump's coalition and protect his own future political ambitions by preventing Musk from launching a breakaway political movement.

item.title: Did Trump back Russia’s claims? What he said about the reported attack on Putin’s residence
item.description: Russia accused Ukraine of a drone attack on President Putin's residence, a claim Kyiv denies. Donald Trump, informed by Putin, expressed anger over the alleged strike, calling it "not good" and ill-timed for peace talks. Russia vowed retaliation, while Ukraine warned the incident could be used to justify further attacks.

item.title: ‘Israel would not exist today without Netanyahu’: Trump praises Israeli PM at Mar-a-Lago
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated that Israel would not exist today without Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, praising his leadership during a meeting. Trump also warned Iran against rebuilding nuclear facilities. Netanyahu reciprocated the praise, calling Trump an unparalleled friend to Israel and the free world.

item.title: 'Your vote will mean nothing': Elon Musk claims ‘radical left’ is using immigration to take over US elections
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk has voiced strong opinions on immigration and elections. He alleges that the radical left is using government programs to bring in immigrants. Musk claims this is done to win elections and create a single-party state. He cited Ilhan Omar's election as an example. Musk warned that if this trend continues, citizens' votes will become meaningless. Read here!

item.title: 'I have two jobs': Donald Trump reveals his ‘construction job’ and why he’s renovating the White House
item.description: President Donald Trump juggles his presidential duties with extensive renovation projects. He describes his construction work as relaxation, undertaking significant upgrades at the White House and the Kennedy Center. These elaborate and costly renovations include a new ballroom in the East Wing and marble replacements.

item.title: 'Hotness should get an exemption': Elon Musk makes bizarre comment over deportation of Danish teen
item.description: Elon Musk commented on Audrey Morris, a teen facing deportation from Denmark. Morris found his remark about her looks shocking. She stated her case became about appearances, not her achievements. Morris was nearly deported from Denmark, her home for years. She eventually received a residency permit but not citizenship. Musk himself faced deportation threats previously. Read here to know more!

item.title: Full list of countries on IShowSpeed’s Africa tour as it officially begins
item.description: IShowSpeed has launched his ambitious 28-day "Speed Does Africa" IRL tour, visiting 20 countries across the continent. The live-streamed project, beginning December 29, 2025, on YouTube and Twitch, aims for fan engagement, football action, and cultural immersion. Early streams from Angola have already showcased viral fan interactions, setting the tone for the extensive creator-led travel livestream.
